text:
nina.partnerships: Heads-up 1: we're kicking off the "Shadow Mentor" onboarding pilot for SIs w/ cloud marketplace integrations. Pilot cohort goes live Mon 4/8. Need to finalize: mentor roster, checklist for partner-facing demo, certification pass criteria, and whether to offer hosted sandboxes or offline kits. Who can own each piece?

arun.enablement: I can lead the cert rubric + mentor playbook. Propose 3-tier badges: Explorer (attendance), Practitioner (lab pass), Integrator (proctored demo). Will draft by Thu.

paul.si-lead: From SI ops side: we'll need the lab to show Marketplace listing + private deployment flow. Hands-on exercise should include 1) deploy model to Dedicated, 2) create Marketplace listing metadata, 3) test fallback to hosted.

mei.ops: Note on sandboxes: Hosted partner sandboxes require 48h provisioning; please submit requests via the partner-sandbox form. If you need same-week access, we should use the offline ZIP. Also Dedicated pool maintenance scheduled Sat 02:00 UTC may affect test windows.

tom.training: I have an offline facilitator bundle (slides, proctor guide, remediation lab). Suggest proctored demos be recorded and a live 20-min QA with trainer. Pass threshold: 75% functional checklist + successful end-to-end deploy.

arun.enablement: That pass threshold sounds reasonable. I'll map checklist items to badge levels. Also adding a short multiple-choice eval (10 q) for Practitioner badge.

nina.partnerships: Ownership recap: Arun -> cert rubric + playbook; Tom -> facilitator kit + proctor SOP; Paul -> SI exercise spec and mentor roster; Mei -> sandbox provisioning ops. I'll collate and send invites for pilot kickoff Tue 09:30 PT.

paul.si-lead: I'll confirm 4 mentors by EOD Wed and include contact emails. Quick ask: can you add a template for Marketplace metadata? Saves time.

tom.training: Template for metadata + deploy checklist incoming. Also will include a short snippet we can paste into SI-runbooks: ```yaml
marketplace:
  title: "Redwood - SI demo"
  tags: ["inference","private-deploy"]
  contact: "partner@example.com"
```

mei.ops: Filing CAP ticket now for sandbox capacity and flagging maintenance window: CAP-9921. If anyone needs staging DNS entries, ping me.

arun.enablement: I'll publish the initial playbook draft (slides + 10q) to the partner repo by Thu 5pm PT and link it in this thread.

nina.partnerships: Great. One more thing 1: for legal/MSA pilot terms, I'll ask legal to fast-track a short annex covering sandbox usage and recording consent. Will share the doc for review.

ci-bot: CI build for partner-playbooks passed: build/partner-playbooks@1.4.2.

paul.si-lead: Thanks everyone. Small timeline check: if mentors confirmed Wed and playbook by Thu, we can run internal dry-run Fri and pilot start Mon. Sounds good to me.

arun.enablement: Agreed. I'll schedule a 30m dry-run Fri 11am PT and share calendar invite.

nina.partnerships: Perfect 1: I'll compile the final checklist and send the kickoff invite once mentor list is in. Thanks all!
